Thirty-five, and "none less" — that's the part that stands out. Not the total so much as there being no day that isn't a drinking day.

You just put the real number in writing. First time it's been outside your head in five weeks, and it didn't take a form to do it.

The arithmetic was never going to give you the answer, but the number itself is something she can actually work with — and "none less" is the detail a doctor would care about most.
